mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,resume_version_id,version,facts_json,created_by,created_at FROM ai_hr_fact_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND candidate_id=#{candidateId} ORDER BY version DESC

SELECT id,tenant_id,department_id,current_snapshot_id,version,consent_policy_id,acquired_at,expires_at,status FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at > #{now} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,tenant_id,department_id,current_snapshot_id,version,consent_policy_id,acquired_at,expires_at,status FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at > #{now}
SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,resume_version_id,version,facts_json,created_by,created_at FROM ai_hr_fact_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_candidate SET current_snapshot_id=#{snapshotId},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
UPDATE ai_hr_matching_result SET status='STALE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND candidate_id=#{candidateId} AND status='CURRENT'
